annotator_agreement.note: the consensus view takes the majority label and treats a contested pair as not a conflict, so a contested pair can only lower the measured precision, never raise it. Every annotator is also scored alone, so the spread across annotators is visible rather than hidden by the tie-break.

overall.note: precision_any_flag is the fraction of the detector's alarms that correspond to a real conflict of any type -- detection. precision_typing is the fraction whose branch is the branch that owns the conflict -- typing. recall_any_real_problem is the fraction of the annotated conflicts the detector alarms on at all

revision.note: the revision stratum is two issues of the same provision by construction, so its conflict type is known independently of any annotation; the branch distribution says which branch the detector used
